staffBearer.description: Staff and admin endpoints require an authenticated user. The credential is issued by Task 5's auth surface (Fortify + Sanctum), which is not built yet: before then the only resolver is a test harness that reads a container binding and refuses to run outside local and testing, so no credential of any kind is accepted in a deployed environment. These endpoints are therefore NOT public, and a client that omits authentication receives 401.
